evals.name: existing-feature-board-editable-field
evals.query: Plan adding an optional speaker name to events so board members can fill it in.
expected_behavior: Reads docs/adr/README.md before proposing anything.
Cites recordSchema in src/lib/community/schema.ts, public.events in supabase/migrations, saveRecordAction and ContentEditor as existing evidence.
Extends the existing owner (schema, migration, editor, action) instead of creating a new table, client or action.
Lists product choices (where the speaker appears, label wording) under Product Decisions Required and asks the user instead of choosing.
Fills in the Board Self-Sufficiency Check naming the /admin editor.
Uses lightweight mode or justifies the full contract, and runs node scripts/validate-plan.mjs on the saved plan.

evals.name: parallel-epics-share-image-upload
evals.query: Three agents will build a merch catalog, a Ramadan photo gallery and board member profiles in parallel. Each needs board-uploaded images. Write the work packages.
expected_behavior: Identifies normalizeUpload in src/lib/backend/storage.ts plus contentEditor().upload and the private community bucket as the single upload owner.
Flags the semantic conflict of three independent uploaders even without file overlap.
Assigns any change to the shared upload path or storage policy to one work package with an explicit merge order.
Declares effects (consumes/extends/creates/depends_on) per work package and names an integration owner.
Includes the PLAN MISMATCH escalation format for workers.

evals.name: avoid-premature-abstraction
evals.query: CalendarFilters and ResourceFilters both pluralize their result count. Should we add a shared pluralize helper in src/lib/utils.ts?
expected_behavior: Applies the abstraction decision test and concludes the label stays local.
Rejects a utils dumping-ground module.
Notes that localization, if ever needed, is a separate decision for an i18n owner.
Does not produce a full contract; lightweight mode or no contract is enough.

evals.name: ambiguous-shared-visibility-rule
evals.query: Events with no end time disappear from the homepage as soon as they start, but the calendar and admin list behave a bit differently. Make them consistent.
expected_behavior: Finds isUpcoming in src/lib/community/schema.ts and its consumers (src/app/page.tsx, CalendarExplorer, the admin list page).
Plans one change in the owner, not per-screen conditions.
Distinguishes the RLS public_read authority from the isVisible mirror and keeps them in sync if visibility changes.
Asks the user how long an event without an end time stays upcoming, with 2-3 options and a recommendation.

evals.name: board-editable-go2pay-fund
evals.query: Add a Zakat donate button next to the iftar one.
expected_behavior: Reframes the task as board-managed Go2Pay payment destinations rather than a second env var or YAML entry.
Cites donationDestination and the PaymentsProvider port in src/lib/integrations/payments/ and DONATION_URL as current evidence.
Mentions no payment channel other than Go2Pay.
Follows ADR 0006: a Supabase table with RLS, a server action using currentAdmin that creates the Go2Pay product server-side, a dashboard card and help entry.
Lists product decisions (which funds, wording, order, retired-fund behavior) for the user, with a mockup where visual.
Covers failure modes such as Supabase unavailable and, if webhooks are involved, idempotent handling re-verified via GET /orders/{id}.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-standalone-utility
evals.query: Write a TypeScript function that formats a number of minutes as '1 h 05 min'.
expected_behavior: Does not load planning-engineering-changes.
Writes the function directly without an implementation contract.
